reviews.text:
I am requesting a full refund for the charge. Dear Customer Support Team,

I am writing to formally dispute recurring charges for an application that I purchased only once and cancelled afterward. I no longer use this app, and it does not appear in my list of active subscriptions or apps, however, I continue to be charged every year without my authorization.

I reported this issue last year, but despite my previous complaint, I was charged again this year. I did not authorize this renewal, and I request an immediate investigation into why these charges continue to occur.

I am requesting a full refund for the charge that was recently made to my account, as this renewal was not authorized and the cancellation had already been requested previously. I also request that you immediately cancel any existing subscription associated with my account, ensure that no future charges will be processed, and provide written confirmation that this issue has been resolved.

I would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and confirmation once the refund and cancellation have been completed.

Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
Coraly Hernandez

Lifetime member. Even restoring purchase as I have grandfathered in the lifetime as an early buyer of the app, now even after they say have full access, I have limited access to the content compared to what they used to offer.
Great app. I’ve been using Asana Rebel for a few years now, I’ve recommended it to several friends. It’s great, I absolutely love it 👍🏼

Cancel subscription. Cancelled my annual subscription three months in. Since it was an annual I was able to use the remaining months that I had paid for. I was just charged again for another annual subscription. When I go to the app it shows that I do not currently have a membership. There is a button that says cancel anytime however the hyperlink doesn’t work. Likely because i don’t have an active subscription. There is no way to contact anyone directly. I googled how to cancel. Found several landing pages that went nowhere. Eventually came across two separate emails tied to the company. I sent an email to both explaining the situation. I get back well we don’t see an active membership on our end. Check the app, check google play, check PayPal and lastly check your apple subscriptions. It was none of these mind you, needless to say no accountability so now I’m dealing with my bank. Just beware if you’re considering signing up there may be recurring charges that show up unauthorized.

Good Yoga Program. It would rate 5 stars but there are issues when it communicates with my apple health. The calories and work out time do not match what Asana Rebel claims. For those who want to start at the basic and into advanced levels this is my favorite!

Used to be my favorite app, no more. It’s pretty incredible how quickly I have soured on this app. I have done basically every workout on the app, used to love them. Now? Not so much. Why are there no new workouts? What would you say our $71.99 pays for? Do you plan on releasing any new workouts soon? How about a new challenge set? Beyond that, why can’t a track what I’ve done so that I can avoid repeating workouts over and over again? The lack of new content is frustrating, I’m afraid this will be my final subscription period unless this app makes significant improvements.
Back to basics. Great start. Smoooooooth.

Scam Recharge. Zero stars 
My best advice is: Do not download app! Do not give them any type of credit card information-unless you want to be charged for the rest of your life. 
Seriously! 
I Canceled my membership a full year ago. 
Today out of the blue they charged me again. Even though I have not used the app in 365 days & I have a confirmation of it being canceled.
No help via customer serviced either. There is No customer phone number to call -just an email from a bot saying ‘our subscription is clear-you will be charged’. 
I am SURE they can see that: 
1) I cancelled the membership 1 year ago
2)There has been NO activity on this app. 
It is an utter theft of your money.
Nope. App is glitchy and very suspicious. Lots of trackers. I do not recommend
Over 3 years using App. I love the workouts, wish you would add some new flows that are a little longer.

Great addition to wellness routine. Wide variety of classes, and more are added all the time, that help meet your needs on different days/to achieve different goals. For example some days I want to feel relaxed and less anxious, some days I want to feel energized and powerful! I love the music and meditation options as well.
Recommend. Had the app, then cancelled to start a diff app. BUT I CAME BACK to this one. :)

Horrible. I logged in with Apple, paid for a subscription, it logged me out and deleted all my progress. I tried to log in with my email on my iPad, and won’t let me. So I can’t use the app across multiple devices. Contacting Apple to get my money back.
Scam. Don’t fall for the ads. Workouts are basic and not doing to change your body. Customer service is awful. The whole things feels like a bad fitness/health AI platform.
Rip Off. Absolute rip-off! Not worth the price or the aggravation when trying to cancel a subscription.
Cancelling sucks. You can on cancel the day before your anniversary of superscription. 24 hrs or you are stuck w/ the cost.

Class action law suit 2025. . Cancelling subscriptions through the App Store does NOT stop billing. They bill yearly, silently, even after the subscription is canceled. Contact them directly and dispute the charge on your card.

Hidden Subscription Renewal. I am so angry with this app and the developers. They have chosen to hide the subscription renewal within the website. Not the Apple subscription services tab. A total scam way of handling people who want to cancel their subscription. A very dishonest way of doing business. Do not get suckered like I did.

BUYER BEWARE. If I could give negative reviews I would. I tried this app and it was very meh. Canceled my subscription and here we are a year later and they have tried to charge my card 5 plus times even after I have emailed them each time and told them to quit. They acknowledged my account is not active but yet they continue to try to charge me. DO NOT SIGN UP. THEY WILL CONTINUE TO CHARGE YOU LONG AFTER YOU CANCEL. BUYER BEWARE

False advertising - they’re refusing to refund despite clearly stated 2 week offer. They’re lying about letting people try the app for 2 weeks for free. It’s actually a 13 day free trial. If you try to cancel on the 14th day, they’ll tell you “it’s outside the 14 day eligibility window” and refuse to refund your money. 
The email conversation trying to resolve this has been so bizarre it’s like they have ai chatbots doing their customer support. 
I’m not sure what the stand for as a company, but it’s none of the ethos of yoga.

Don’t expect help. Once they charge you. They don’t care to help. I politely asked for a pro rated refund as I had the renewal date wrong. And I admitted to that. I Havent used the app in months. And with the unrest in my home state of MN I lost track of regular life. They didn’t care. I asked for a refund for the rest of the year discounting the first month. No. Since 14 days had passed. So despite my multiple years of service. They could Care less, and provided zero customer service or care. What kind of personal care are they providing? They just want our money.

Attempted payment again and again. I have been in touch with customer service over the $119 charge renewal - it has been tried on my card 4 different times. In two different email chains they have PROMISED my account was deleted and it wouldn’t happen again and I just got another attempted charge here. FIX THIS!!!

Always charges my card. I’ve canceled this app for years now and it continues to charge me yearly. Of course I don’t find out until it’s done. I’ve went in and canceled subscription through my phone, through the app and online and I’m still getting charged 3 years later.
毎朝、短時間. 習慣化しやすいです♪

This will get you in Shape. Give it time and it will work for you. There are a variety of workouts to target specific areas, whole body, short or long work outs and degrees of intensity. It really works. The choice is yours. Will you be a winner today? Good luck!

Non practical and terrible customer. Did not like the content, it is not progressive at all, don’t offer a good plan. After requesting cancellation within trial period, I did not get my refund back even tho it was filed timely. Don’t get this app

Deceptive and incompetent subscription service. Asana Rebel must be going out of business because they sent me an email saying my annual renewal was $35.99 , charged me $72 and have me in an infinite loop where they ask me over and over the charge amount which I have sent at least 5 times and they just keep asking. DO NOT SUBSCRIBE TO THIS SERVICE unless you want to subject to an infinite incompetent customer service loop to get a refund of their deceptive charges

App did not keep my interest, but the company kept my money. I signed up for this a year ago and did not find it compelling so I never used it. I then missed the cancellation date by less than 24 hours but they charged me for another full year and dismissed my request for leniency. I realize I should have cancelled earlier, but most companies are more forgiving. Do not waste your money.
Renews after cancellation. Stay away!!. Cancelled app and a year later it renews for $119.99. They agreed to cancel it again but will not refund money.

Horrible customer service. Purchased a year ago, had shoulder injury as well as surgery. Canceled subscription yet was charged 119.99. When I reached out they said my subscription was never canceled. I never received any notification of upcoming renewal.They were only willing to provide me a 50% refund even though they can clearly see I haven’t been using the app.

Poor customer service. I wanted to sign up for a monthly subscription, but they charge my card for a year at $36. Then, when it’s time for my yearly membership to renew, and I wanted to cancel, there was no way to do that, either within my Apple subscriptions app Nor through the Asana Rebel app. There was no link for an email or anything. After I complained to them for charging my card again for a yearly membership of $119, they stopped my automatic renewal but kept the money.

Glitchy. Tried downloading 
, updating, and using the app and can’t even make a profile. Buttons to choose gender and other items are blank

Dishonest Company. If you intend on subscribing, you better hope you spend a lot of time in the app because if you forget it will renew you with no notice outside the app and they refuse to refund you, even minutes after the charge hits.

This developer response is insulting given the email responses I have received from them. They have absolutely no interest in righting any wrongs, nor getting any better.

workouts well done. app needs help. so far i find the workouts very good, challenging and well instructed. my only issue is with the app as i have difficulty convincing it to go into landscape on an iphone 15 with ios 26.1. most of the time i give up and leave it in portrait which sometimes cuts off what the instructor is doing. edit. i want to point out it isnt a problem with my phone. i can orient the phone and other apps just fine. this app doesnt follow phone orientation very well.

Cancel subscription. I do not like this program. It was slow, but hard for me to please cancel my subscription!
Thank you!

Automatically charges even after cancellation. Don’t get this app under a free trial period. They have automatically charged my credit card two years in a row after I canceled it in the first month of the trial.
Trying to cancel for years. Every January I’m charged even though I’ve “successfully” cancelled this subscription. This is a joke! I want my money back!

Borderline fraud. I tried it out and paid a full year. It auto renewed without a notification and the same day I asked for cancellation and refund. They said that it cannot be processed as per their terms. 
The product is buggy, poor in quality and their customer success unprofessional. They plan to make money from people who forget to delete their accounts. Good luck to them

Difficult to cancel. I’ve been using the app for few years and I liked it. I did all the challenges and there is nothing new and challenging for me anymore I tried to cancel and I couldn’t because I switched to iPhone and don’t have access to my old google account. Tried customer support but it keeps glitching. Left it for later when I have more time. Then I got charged $119.99 for the renewal . I sent an email and finally got to cancel but I don’t get a refund, because of their policy…I found the email in my spam folder… how I’m I suppose to see it? Now I’m stuck paying for an app that I’m not going use. VERY DISAPPOINTED.

Charged without notice, refund refused. I was charged for an annual renewal, a substantial amount, without notice. I hadn’t actively used the app in at least six months, and contacted customer support within moments of being alerted of the charge. Despite the immediate response and explanation of our family’s circumstances, my refund request was flatly denied.

For a company that markets mindfulness and personal growth, this rigid and profit-driven response shows little concern for users. 

Buyer beware, they won’t notify you before a charge, and they won’t help you when that unexpected charge comes through.

Unauthorized charges. I downloaded this app to see its features but never used it not authorized payment. It’s not even showing in my subscriptions. Today I was charged $119.99, not once but twice. How is this possible? This is not acceptable. Please refund 2x $119.99 immediately.

Don’t fall for it!. The app is buggy and workouts are boring- not yoga at all. The videos don’t track completion properly, so when you’re doing a series it won’t allow you to move forward. Don’t fall for the intro price, it’s $119, which is ludicrous

Won’t refund even when I didn’t authorize. I joined a year ago, bought a year subscription, used it a few times and deleted the app. I knew I paid for a year, I knew I was out the money. I was 100% sure I did not sign up for auto renewal. Well…they just charged my card for another year. I reached out the day the withdrawal hit my account. They said they wouldn’t do anything about it because they sent me an email letting me know it would be renewing. 
If a company has to give you a million reasons why they are in the right for not refunding your money, I don’t want any part of that company. They offered to give me 6 months free. I guess they weren’t listening when I told them I used the app and wasn’t impressed. I don’t want 6 months “free” so they can have the opportunity to charge my card again. 
I feel like they are dishonest and GREEDY.

god help us all. get out while you can. I haven't been charged crazy the way other people have but i could see that happening. This entire thing is AI... it's so creepy. I just did my first yoga lesson and it's completely AI...dystopian. horrifying. And they have AI responses to these reviews and I wouldn't be surprised if the whole thing was just invented by a robot. Really scary. canceling now..if they let me.

Great workouts but social media advertising misleading - needs new challenges. I’ve had the app now for a few years. The workouts are really good but it doesn’t seem like anything has been added in a really long time. The New Year challenge still even says 2024. I keep seeing in my social media feeds that they are starting these new challenges, specifically wall Pilates and the new year challenge, but the new year challenge is still the 2024 one and there is no wall Pilates. Though they did add a Pilates workout collection, it’s not a challenge and it’s not wall Pilates. If you are thinking about it I would still recommend signing up for a year because the workouts are great, but maybe cancel after that. I cancelled mine because there hasn’t been a new challenge in years and that’s my favorite part.

Issues. I’ve been really enjoying the app but lately I’ve experienced glitches. Last one is the app sends me notifications for subscription renewal at a “holiday price” but the actual purchase won’t go through. I’m told to “contact developer” but there’s no option for that. Beyond frustrating. Guess my subscription will expire soon…
Love it but…. I wish they’d update the challenges and workouts. I’ve been using four years and may cancel if there aren’t more updates by this spring.

Love the app! But…. The layout of the app is organized and very easy to navigate. The video quality of each workout is great. You can tell there was effort put into this and not just something thrown together to make a quick dollar. My only complaint is, as a beginner in yoga and telling the app I’m a beginner, the videos go way too fast. I’m getting my feet and knees lined up in the proper position and the guy in the video is already in full dog position. Otherwise, no complaints.

Subscription?. I loved this app. It has good options for short and longer yoga workouts. Sadly, I quit using it and cancelled because it lacks motivation when you’re paying for a subscription when there is little to no new content.

They refuse to let you cancel a subscription. Yoga is fine, but they make it really hard to cancel a subscription and do not alert you to the fact that they’re going to charge you. When you reach out to them, they ignore you. It’s unacceptable for subscription services like this to behave this way. Sketchy company with sketchy policies, steer clear.

Will NOT let me cancel subscription. I have been trying to cancel my subscription for over a year now. I thought I accomplished it and deleted the app from my phone, but I have just been charged again. I can’t get anyone to actually help me and will be going to the BBB about this situation. If I could give zero stars, I would.

Outdated New Years Challenge. Nothing new is being added. The new years challenge is from 2024 and we’re a few weeks away from 2026. Loved this app but I won’t be renewing due to the
the lack of new content

Nothing like the advertisement. Only for young, overly fit individuals who like rigorous movements. I do not see any of the exercises that are advertised. I feel scammed and there is no refund unfortunately.

I love this app! Need more moves!. Love the app, would love more moves and challenges! I would if more Pilates was added. Some more challenges. The instructors are amazing and I use this app daily. It really gets me to where I need to be mindfully and physically. But to be honest, I need more variety. Due to some injuries, I cannot do all of the workouts, so having some for injured persons would be amazing. Maybe some more meditations. I love them. But there aren’t many. I also love listening to the music. They really help with focus. I would love more variety. Thank you for creating this. It has changed my world. And my body!

Charged after canceling. I cancelled this subscription over a year ago and they charged me for it again this year. Now they claim they can’t find any account associated with me and are refusing to refund the money they STOLE from me.

Ok for the first year. This app is mediocre in terms of yoga. It will aggressively remind you to do workouts if you select that. 
The first year is pretty cheap, but they are sneaky with their auto-renewal. It does NOT show up in your Apple subscriptions. They auto renew completely on their own and you have to email them to cancel. I had a problem with them receiving my emails, even though I sent several and missed the “14 day refund policy”. They told me they were being generous in refunding half of the $78 they charged me and cancelling my access immediately. 
There’s better apps with more honest policies and better workouts. I suggest Playbook or the Apple fitness app over this one. Don’t fall for the fancy marketing.

New content needed. I love the sleep meditation with Cory Muscara. Everything else is just ok. I didn’t feel the ads on social accurately depicted what I got. Ultimately this app has potential but I’ll try something else.

No autorenewal warning. WARNING: This app has no autorenewal warning and they aren’t willing to refund your money upon renewal, so set your calendar reminder. Very disappointing, considering I haven’t opened the app in a year and am out $70 for another year that I won’t use this program.

They Are Difficult. Not only are the workouts/yoga flows and meditations subpar, they also give Super Bad customer service. There is nothing worse than a company who doesn’t value its customers. Maybe you can get away with it now-a-days, screwing people over under the radar - but honestly, investing in people or companies like this only lands you in the same place. And the money is not worth it for what they are offering. Such a disappointment and waste of my time and energy.

Unethical subscription service. Greedy subscription service, you will not get a reminder that your subscription will renew. I did not want to renew. I noticed the day they charged me, I contacted them for a refund and they wouldn’t refund me = Bad business
Total Scam. Pretty pictures… no substance…. Cancelled subscription and keeps billing

Fraud. This app has continued to charge me for YEARS after I cancelled my subscription. It managed to charge me on a credit card for an account that should be closed and I now have Kate fees and a bill 5 years later! Do not sign up!

SCAM. Predatory billing practices. Will suddenly increase price and auto-bill you for renewals without notifying you a renewal is coming up. Refuse to refund. The yoga poses are boring and basic, did not result in the improvements they promised.

Scam app alert!. I haven’t used or updated the app in nearly a year, and today, without any notification or heads up of any sort, they have charged me $119.99. They are refusing to refund. This is definitely fraudulent and I will be reporting this app.

Love it, but please add more challenges!!. This app is fantastic, I love the workouts and the instructors do a great job. I can always find something to fit the mood I’m in from an easy stretch to an intense workout. The only thing I wish would be different is that we would get new challenges. The last new years challenge is from 2024 and we’re almost to 2026. New exercises and challenges on a regular basis would be fantastic, especially for those of us who use it on a regular basis and love new challenges.

Able to Grease the Wheels even with glitches. As an avid mover (weights, HIIT and Cardio 6 days/Week) I downloaded AR post surgery to keep me moving and gently work/stretch affected area. This is great to either start the day, or wind down (or both) both mentally and physically. 

My ONLY FRUSTRATION is the app can be glitchy and God forbid an alarm goes off or you get a phone call. It will stop the workout and then you have to start the whole thing over or you lose our sit and streak, it won’t count your workout. Very frustrating in friendly competitions. The Apple Watch app (Ultra 2) can use some attention too, it will not go away until you close the app on the phone.

Back to my normal routine, I still use Asana Rebel daily to compliment my other workouts. Don’t be fooled, these yoga workouts may calm the mind but they will also kick your butt. Great for all levels: starting out or movement-enthusiasts like myself. Keep moving.

New feature awful. Please remove, make optional, or make more subtle, the “your next workout” pop-up recently implemented. I’m wrapping up a successful yoga session, maybe in shavasana or enjoying my last downward dog, when suddenly the instructor’s voice is interrupted with a loud DING and the session is cut off, replaced by a stressful countdown to another session I don’t have time for!? And I need to exit my pose to click “ignore” and get the last 8 seconds of my session. This does not feel like it was user tested for a positive experience.

Auto Subscription Scam. I paid for a 1 year subscription. Used the app less than 5 times over the course of a year. Without warning or any communication, they renewed my subscription for $79 and are now refusing to give me a refund. No customer service whatsoever. Easy way to lose people’s trust. Terrible experience.

Scammers. I tried this app and it just wasn’t for me which is fine. I was OK with their initial charge because it was on me to use it but I did cancel my subscription, specifically to avoid being charged again and again. I keep very up-to-date on my Apple account and cancel from there. This is now the second year in a row that they have charged me without telling in advance, without it showing up on my Apple subscription page, and with no way to have avoided the charge because I already canceled it! This is terrible practice and a complete breach of contract. I see so many people saying the same thing over and over again in the reviews. They keep apologizing for it, but not doing anything about it clearly. Don’t even get involved from the start that would be my advice.

UPDATE: I had my bank cancel the charge and they emailed me multiple times to alert me that my subscription needed a new card. This was after never having emailed me to let me know they were gonna charge me. I finally responded and said I don’t want to have an account anymore and then somebody immediately emailed me back and confirmed to cancellation.

Be Careful with Subscription!!. This company will charge you for a subscription whether you have terminated via the app store or not. Be extremely cautious with providing credit card information - they will not refund and the cancellation policy in no way considers the consumer. Suggest caution!
Terrible customer service. They will renew your subscription and raise the price without ever notifying you and then they will not process a refund.
Terrible customer service. They don’t alert you before your plan renews and they will not offer refunds. Customer service is nonexistent

Evil!. This is a company that will literally steal money from you! I canceled my subscription last year and then noticed they charged me again this year. I tried to get a refund and they wouldn’t refund my money. Saying I never canceled my subscription. They are liars and they will steal your money. Beware! There are a ton of bad reviews about this company online.
Love this program. What a great value for everything you need. I really needed to get back into yoga and with the videos and meditation and everything else this app has it is everything I wanted.

Can’t delete. This app is hard to navigate and impossible to cancel if it doesn’t work for you. At this time I can’t beget into my account to cancel but I can reset my password. It doesn’t recognize my email as a real email to log in. But does to reset my password.

Run away - you’ll get a better workout. Mediocre app with terrible customer service.. Found no value in the app, and didn’t use after initial purchase, they apparently auto renewed without any notification a year later, and when I saw the credit card charge and requested a refund, they declined because I didn’t do it in the appropriate time. But was never notified of a renewal.

Buyer beware. The customer service is awful. I regret ever having downloaded this app. If you do subscribe, make sure to watch your subscription. They automatically renew and refuse to reverse the charge, even if you write to cancel immediately. A scam.

HORRIBLE APP!. First I hurt myself using this app, it is horrible for beginners or even intermediate. There was NO NOTICE sent to remind me to renew, even though purchase wasn’t through App Store, so I had no idea how to cancel, when it was set to renew or anything until it auto renewed! Their customer service was non-existent, just “we’re doing everything” which was NOTHING! There are so many good apps out there, and this is NOT ONE OF THEM - DO NOT DOWNLOAD! Do not use unless you want to get hurt, and definitely don’t expect them to help! I regret this purchase with everything I have! AVOID THEM!
SCAM!. They will continue to charge you even if you cancel. Also, they charge you more than double what you originally agreed to. Their “Customer Service” is terrible!!! DO NOT DOWNLOAD!!!

I love it, except for one thing. I’ve been using this app for years and I absolutely love the exercises! Seriously top notch stuff. I have one issue though. When it’s been a while since I’ve used the app it says “welcome back” when I open it and then asks me why I haven’t been using it. I’m sure it’s supposed to be for you guys to get a better idea of what hinders people etc, but I just hate it so much. Can we please just pretend that I haven’t been on a six week hiatus? Haha, but for real. It’s disheartening to be called out for not exercising

Beware! Charged even though I asked to cancel. Like so many others here I got hit for a renewal fee. I hadn’t used the app and don’t plan to. Contacted them immediately and asked that they reverse the charge as I did not want to renew. I asked several times and was flat out refused every time.
Billed $120.00! Way to take care of your customers.

Great but needs one thing. I really enjoy this program. I lift weights and do some cardio but this brings my warm up to a new level. The only thing I have had issues with is air play. For some reason it doesn't like the screen sharing. I have to set it up on the app to get the landscape view to come up and then share it. Took me 20 minutes to figure that out the first time. Other than that small issue, I am glad I signed up.

BEWARE!. This company will NOT warn you upfront via email or any other communication that they plan to charge you $71 for a year. After they charge you, even if you cancel and reach out to them for a refund, they will refuse to give you a refund! I’m currently working other methods to get my money back from this scam company!
Fraud. Careful! If you cancel from within the app, they will reactivate your subscription and charge you.

Impossible to cancel. I signed up in 2023 for $35. The price is now more than $70 and I have requested a cancellation several times using the email option. Do me this has proven to be an ineffective means to manage my subscription. The directions they provide do not match my experience. While the app itself is fine the inability to cancel a service I no longer wish to receive is my reason for a low rating.
Watch Out for Automatic Renewal. Was unaware this was up for renewal and was charged. Requested a refund as I do not use this app and was denied.
Shady consumer practices. Asana Rebel engages in poor consumer practices by making subscription cancellations and refunds unnecessarily difficult, leaving customers feeling misled and trapped.

Auto Subscription warning. There is no notice that you will be charged for your yearly auto renewal and therefore you cannot cancel your subscription before you are charged again. An exploitative business tactic. Be warned!

Do not subscribe. I subscribed to Asana Rebel in September of 2023, I canceled my subscription on 09/16/2023 and stopped receiving any emails from them leading me to believe the subscription was canceled. I recently found out through my bank that I was being charged for the subscription for the last 2 years. The company is unwilling to hear my case or refund me. Do with that what you will, and if you do subscribe, make sure you don’t delete the cancellation email because they will not help you.

Nice at home app. I like the workouts better than other apps I have tried. Some of the music has been louder than instruction voice and I have had two where they say left side but video shows demo on right or vise versa. Also annoying is your videos don’t rotate with the screen once you hit play. Sometimes it works but not always. And I am mirroring to tv so once set up I turn the phone landscape for the tv and half the time I see an end of mat only. This needs to be fixed and I could give 5 stars

Bait and switch. I signed up for this app two years ago. For a while I couldn’t get the app to even work. And then they made it incredibly difficult to cancel this service - and despite trying to cancel my account, it remained active and I continued to get charged. It looks like they’ve made it easier now to cancel, but unfortunately I’ve been charged again for an app I’ve never used. I THINK it’s finally cancelled, but they won’t refund me despite all these issues! Just beware.

Disappointed. Am new to Yoga, and started the intro class. Tried using on multiple devices including casting to my TV … but the speed of instruction was too fast … and so absolutely NOT great for a beginner. Ultimately I started going to an in person class, which was way better. 

So why the one star you might ask? Answer … Entirely my customer service experience. Got a notice that my annual subscription was renewing (not from Asana Rebel BTW … but from my financial institution), contacted Asana for a refund … their answer … absolutely not. 

There might have been a moment where I’d use Asana Rebel again, but after this experience… I’d sooner flush $120 down the toilet … oh wait … I did that already! 🤣

Literal Scammers. SCAMMERS

These people charged me for a full year subscription service well after I had cancelled my subscription. I cancelled the auto-renewal for this application and the app was not even listed within my subscribed apps on my phone but I suddenly got the charge in my account.
